parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit; a retry
reuses it) that makes a retried request safe. Required on every POST
(a PUT accepts it too); answered with 400 `idempotency-key-required`
when absent and 400 `idempotency-key-invalid` when it is longer than
128 characters or not printable ASCII. A replay with the same key and
the same request (method, path and body) returns the stored response
with the header `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with a
different request is a 409 `idempotency-key-reused`.

parameters.name: caseId
parameters.description: The case id (`case-` followed by a unique suffix, at most 64 characters).
